entry.description: Release 0.8.0. A stdlib argparse console entry point, zero new runtime dependency. rand-engine list prints the cases; rand-engine get-started <case> [--out DIR] writes one short .py in Databricks source format (# Databricks notebook source / # COMMAND ----------) that also runs locally with python file.py. Non-interactive, complete --help, deterministic output, meaningful exit codes. Exactly 5 cases, no more: (1) DataFrame for tests with null_rate/anomaly_rate; (2) pk/fk related tables to a parquet lake; (3) event stream for Kafka, stdout by default, producer block ready; (4) Spark/Databricks notebook with native SparkGenerator plus a short note on DataGenerator-only features and the createDataFrame path for small volumes; (5) Faker pools at NumPy speed. Every generated file is executed in CI. New public surface: needs a minor version and must be named in the SPEC per constitution invariant 1.
